description.title: Childhood vulnerability to victimisation in England and Wales: combined years ending March 2023 to March 2025
description.summary: Victimisation and negative behaviours of children aged 10 to 15 years living in a household with an adult who reported experiencing domestic abuse, substance misuse and mental ill-health (the so-called "toxic trio" factors) based on findings from the Crime Survey for England and Wales (CSEW).
